data.content_ref: inline:The computation that the total is exactly 300 pages is compatible with the assumption that 'starting from 1' excludes unnumbered front matter from the 792-digit count, inheriting the absence of a starting offset; it is refuted if front matter (e.g., roman numerals i–vi) is included in the 792 digits, because the starting offset would shift and the total page count would differ.
